bullets.text: Cases have been registered against two female wardens in Chennai and Nagercoil for harassing a plus-one student, and the office should monitor the police investigation.
A 34-year-old woman named Nithyasree died after a private bus ran over her moped near Nazarethpet, and the office should watch for updates on road safety measures.
Two persons arrested in the Thiruttani petty shop vendor murder case have been detained under the Goondas Act, and the office should track local law and order.
Officials in Thiruttani are reportedly denying 125 days of work to persons with disabilities under the rural employment guarantee scheme, and the district team must investigate.
A Panimalar Engineering College student from Poonamallee secured an annual salary of Rs 1.2 crore at Meril Diagnostics, and the office should acknowledge this local achievement.
The Tamil Nadu government allocated Rs 125 crore in the first phase for a scheme providing AI assistive devices to persons with disabilities, and the portfolio team should track the rollout.

takeaways: A 34-year-old woman named Nithyasree died when a private bus hit her moped near Nazarethpet on Thursday.
